title: Reject duplicate JSON fields in canonical records
summary: Make record loading reject duplicate member names in ideas and features, including nested objects, with a path-specific diagnostic. A Lydite report and a disposable check of Provenistem v0.0.2 both observed conflicting fields passing validation.

origin.source: Lydite Test Vault issue #121 and the Provenistem adopter bug audit on 2026-11-20.

benefits: Preserves one unambiguous reading of each canonical record.
risks: Existing records with duplicate fields require deliberate reconciliation before they can pass the stricter validator.

evidence.claim: The Lydite adopter report documents duplicate-field acceptance.
The v0.0.2 record loader produced the same outcome in a disposable check.
